about: Ai4Qi audit library. Audits are real where a source is given. Topic judgements are written by Claude from the detailed audits and should be checked by a consultant.

topic_knowledge.topic: Supracondylar fracture nerve and vessel documentation
topic_knowledge.usual_baseline: Under half fully documented; anterior interosseous nerve worst, as low as 10%
topic_knowledge.fix_that_works: A proforma, ideally electronic and built into clerking. Compliance rises to 70–95%.
topic_knowledge.fix_that_fails: Teaching alone; gains fade when the proforma isn't used
topic_knowledge.consultant_advice: Done at least seven times with the same finding and fix. Don't repeat it. Audit whether the proforma is still used a year on, or audit documentation after manipulation, which nobody measures.
topic_knowledge.evidence: Detailed records in this library; judgement written by Claude from them

topic_knowledge.usual_baseline: Several Royal College items recorded in under 10% of notes; post-op plan and tourniquet time often poor
topic_knowledge.fix_that_works: Typed or electronic template. One unit went from 9.5% to 67% typed notes; post-op instructions from 40% to 92%.
topic_knowledge.fix_that_fails: Templates don't fix items surgeons don't know: estimated blood loss stayed at 7–8%
topic_knowledge.consultant_advice: Heavily overdone. Only worth doing if your unit has no electronic template, or if you audit one item templates miss, such as blood loss or implant traceability.
topic_knowledge.evidence: Detailed records in this library; judgement written by Claude from them

topic_knowledge.usual_baseline: About half delayed beyond 36 hours; mean around 49 hours; most delays organisational, not medical
topic_knowledge.fix_that_works: Structural change: extra morning trauma lists (41% to 78% within 36 h), a daytime emergency theatre (delays 49% to 26%), a seven-day consultant rota, or nurse-led vitamin K in ED (median 50 h to 34 h for warfarin patients)
topic_knowledge.fix_that_fails: Teaching or reminders. No audit in the library improved timing without changing capacity or process.
topic_knowledge.consultant_advice: Your data already exists in the national hip fracture database. Don't recollect it. Pick one delay reason from your own data, such as anticoagulation or echo, and change the process behind it.
topic_knowledge.evidence: Detailed records in this library; judgement written by Claude from them
